content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue when trying to use [product_name] from [version_no] to [product_name] in [version_no]. There are no values transferring. Am I missing something? I've tested with different sensors and without sensors, as well as analog input to analog flag. Best regards, [user_name]
Have you enabled S7 access in [product_name] [version_no]? This can be configured via File > Properties > Offline Settings.
No, I hadn't enabled it yet, but I will try now.
If S7 access isn't enabled, [product_name] [version_no] won't be able to exchange data with other [product_name] devices via the S7 connection.
Thank you very much! It's working fine now. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue was difficulty transferring data between two [product_name] modules of different [version_no] due to S7 access not being enabled on one of them. Activating this access in the settings resolved the data exchange problem. This highlights the importance of correct configuration when ensuring interoperability between different module versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated straightforward data transfer between different [product_name] module versions without needing to adjust configuration settings.
